summary: The first-time experience is fast and intuitive early on, with clear lane-switching and jump tutorials leading to quick success. However, late-run speed escalation makes obstacles hard to react to, and the final Game Over screen leaves the player with no clear action before the end card appears.

items.title: Game Over screen lacks any interactive button or transition cue
items.evidence: After crashing at 384m, the screen displays only 'GAME OVER' floating over the track with no buttons or instructions, causing the player's input to have no effect (19% clarity, 2% input effect) before the end card finally appears 2 seconds later.
items.suggestion: Add a brief, clear transition message (e.g., 'Calculating Score...') or immediately display a 'Continue' / 'Play Now' button on the Game Over overlay so players are not left tapping a static screen.

items.title: High speed at 381m leaves too little reaction time for obstacles
items.evidence: At SPD 88, a pink X block appears directly in front of the player's car in the right lane, resulting in an immediate collision and low clarity (46%) on how to avoid it in time.
items.suggestion: Cap the maximum speed slightly lower in the playable ad or increase the spawn distance/telegraphing of pink X blocks at speeds above SPD 80.

items.title: Sudden crash at 227m interrupts flow despite free revive
items.evidence: The player's input had no visible effect right as they hit an obstacle at 227m, triggering the 'CRASHED! Keep your run going?' popup with a 'REVIVE 1 free' button.
items.suggestion: Provide a brief invulnerability flash or slightly more forgiving hitbox on lane transitions so players feel they had a fair chance to dodge before the revive prompt.

items.title: Smooth initial onboarding with 2.0s to first success
items.evidence: The 'Swipe to switch lanes!' prompt with directional arrows and hand indicator allowed the player to successfully switch lanes and dodge within 2.0 seconds.
items.suggestion: Keep the current tutorial pacing; optionally fade out the hand indicator slightly faster once the player begins swiping.
